title: Paytm stock soars to post-listing record, yet below IPO price
text: Paytm stock soars to post-listing record, yet below IPO price. Paytm parent One97 Communications hit a post-listing record high of ₹1,807.5, while Granules India promoter Krishna Prasad Chigurupati offloaded a 6.95% stake for ₹1,501 crore in block deals
